parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the SSL client certificate.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the list. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for paging. Default value: **10**. Valid values: **1** to **50**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the SSL client certificates that you want to query.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the region ID.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the resource group to which the SSL client certificate belongs.

The SSL client certificate belongs to the same resource group as its associated SSL server. You can call the [DescribeSslVpnServers](~~2794078~~) operation to query the resource group ID of the SSL server.

parameters.name: SslVpnClientCertId
parameters.description: The ID of the SSL client certificate.

parameters.name: SslVpnServerId
parameters.description: The ID of the SSL server.
